main.description: Copy a version's blobs into the registry again, after an earlier copy failed. Only the registry's own account may call this. The copy is enqueued for any indexed version and fetches only what is not held yet, so an available version whose optional images failed can be retried. For a version deleted at its source, the copy keeps whatever blobs the publisher's PDS still serves, so instances that installed it can keep loading it by CID, but the version stays deletedAtSource and is never made available.

name.description: The project's name, which is the record key of its software.release.project: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and interior hyphens.

version.description: A semver version without build metadata, with an optional lowercase prerelease, such as `1.2.0` or `1.2.0-beta.1`.

availability.description: The version's availability when the retry was asked for. The copy runs afterwards, so this does not yet reflect it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no repo to write to.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured. An operator problem, not a caller's.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The input breaks a rule the registry applies, so it would refuse the records. The message names the field.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: A record could not be written to the caller's repo. Records written before the failure stay, and the same call can be made again.

errors.name: VersionNotFound
errors.description: No version of that project is indexed at that version string.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Only the registry's own account may retry a copy.
